thread:
Jamie: Proposal: merge route_stats + quota_snapshots into a single route_metrics table to simplify console joins and backfills.

Olga: Shape?

Jamie: Draft columns: `route_id, ts_bucket, model_family, env, tokens_in, tokens_out, errors, quota_window_id, sample_count, updated_at, source_version`

Mike: +1. Need sub-second reads for recent 1h/24h tiles. Index on (route_id, ts_bucket) and partial index for hot recent buckets.

Kira: How do we attach owner & tier? FK or denormalize?

Jamie: Denormalize owner_id and tier into rows to avoid joins on hot reads. Keep FK nullable for offline integrity checks.

Dave: Backfill volume estimate? current stores ~1.2B rows across shards.

Olga: Dual-write during backfill to avoid read-time translation. App-level feature-flag enabled dual-write for safety.

Mike: Backfill plan: per-shard windowed workers, rate-limited, checkpointed per-route. Estimate 2-3 weeks single cluster; parallelize to shorten.

Jamie: Rollout steps:
1) Deploy empty `route_metrics` + partial indexes.
2) Enable dual-write behind flag for 14 days.
3) Start backfill workers with checkpoints and duplicate-write verification.
4) Switch console queries to `route_metrics` under canary (10%).
5) Ramp if checks pass, drop old tables after 30 days of stable traffic.

Mike: SQL sketch:
```
CREATE TABLE route_metrics (
  route_id UUID NOT NULL,
  ts_bucket TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  model_family TEXT,
  env TEXT,
  tokens_in BIGINT,
  tokens_out BIGINT,
  errors INT,
  quota_window_id UUID,
  sample_count INT,
  source_version TEXT,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  PRIMARY KEY (route_id, ts_bucket)
);
CREATE INDEX ON route_metrics (ts_bucket) WHERE ts_bucket > now() - interval '30 days';
```

Kira: Also propose a materialized view for 24h/48h rolling totals refreshed every minute for active routes.

Jamie: Agree. MV will use incremental aggregation and be owned by Console.

Dave: Retention/compaction: 1m buckets for 30d, compact to 1h for 180d, monthly beyond. Compaction job will coalesce and mark replaced rows.

Olga: We'll add a compaction and retention service; document SLOs for backfill and dual-write lag.

Mike: Perf tests needed: run typical dashboard queries on staging with compressed data and our partial indexes. I can help with query harness.

Jamie: I'll schedule perf runs and attach traces. Also add per-route fallback toggle in Console to revert to old tables if metrics look wrong.

devops-bot: migration created: 20260315_1400_add_route_metrics (status: pending)

Olga: I'll draft backfill orchestrator and checkpoint schema tomorrow.

Dave: Include `source_version` in rows so we can distinguish backfilled vs live data during verification.

Jamie: Action items: Mike/Olga add migration & perf tests, Jamie to open Console canary flag PR, Dave to own compaction job design. Closing when PRs merged and perf numbers green. :thumbsup:
